test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
With reference to Manipuri classical dance which of the following statements is correct?

a) Lai Haraoba is the earliest form of Manipuri dance.

b) Ras, Sankirtana and Thang-Ta are the most popular forms of this dance.

c) Manipuri dance has its origin in the Jain traditional dance form.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both a and b**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manipuri classical dance :-**

 
 
• It originated in the Indian state of Manipur and is known for its graceful and fluid movements. 
 
• Manipuri dance has its roots in the ancient Sanskrit texts and the local folk traditions of Manipur.
 
• It is important to note that Manipuri classical dance has been recognized as one of the eight classical dance forms of India by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lai Haraoba:-**

 
 
• It is a traditional ritualistic dance performed during the festival of Yaoshang and is considered to be one of the earliest forms of Manipuri dance.
 
 
 
• **Ras:-**
 
 
• It is a devotional dance that depicts the love between Lord Krishna and Radha.
 
 
 
• **Sankirtana:-**
 
 
• It is a form of devotional singing and dancing.
 
 
 
• **Thang-Ta:-**
 
 
• It is a martial arts form that combines dance and combat techniques.
